visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a young woman with dark hair tied back into a ponytail, positioned in a brightly lit indoor room that appears to be a bedroom. She is wearing a grey ribbed cardigan over a vibrant pink top and is accessorized with silver rings and small star-shaped earrings. As she speaks, her facial expressions are animated, featuring frequent blinks and varied mouth movements, and she uses her right hand to gesture towards her face and temple. The background contains a white dresser and a soft-textured bed, with natural light coming from the side. (2) The camera transitions to closer shots as the woman begins her makeup demonstration, specifically focusing on her eyebrows. She holds a brown Maybelline eyebrow pencil and demonstrates its use on her own brow, with white hair clips keeping her bangs out of the way. The frame occasionally switches to a clean product shot of the eyebrow pencil against a neutral backdrop. Text overlays identifying the brand and product model appear prominently, while the woman's movements remain steady and focused on the application. (3) The sequence continues with the introduction of a brow gel and then a mascara. The camera provides detailed macro shots of the mascara wand and the gel brush, showcasing their textures and shapes. The woman is shown applying the mascara to her eyelashes with a wide-eyed expression to ensure full coverage. The lighting remains bright studio-style, emphasizing the clarity of her skin and the effects of the makeup. (4) In the final phase, the woman holds all the featured products—pencil, gel, and mascara—together in front of her. She delivers closing remarks with a cheerful and engaging facial expression. A graphic overlay featuring a purple Moomin-themed pouch appears on the screen to highlight a promotional offer. The video ends with her smiling warmly at the camera, with the overall scene retaining its clean and minimalist aesthetic.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional makeup tutorial demonstrating how to use Maybelline products to achieve a softer, 'ethereal' look. The creator shares a personal anecdote about being perceived as unapproachable to build rapport before showcasing a three-step routine using an eyebrow pencil, brow gel, and mascara. It concludes with a promotional offer to drive sales.
